subject.title: fix(exec): stop isolated state dirs from moving live approvals

question: Should bare `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` permanently become an independent trust scope, or must OpenClaw preserve an explicit migration path for the documented pre-2026.6.6 approval relocation contract?
rationale: The PR fixes cross-scope mutation by retiring a shipped migration and fail-closed policy; choosing permanent isolation versus explicit relocation changes both effective exec security and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Preserve explicit relocation
options.body: Keep isolation as the default but require a deliberate source-and-target-confirmed doctor action to migrate old approval state.

options.title: Retire relocation support
options.body: Treat every custom state directory as new independent state and require users to recreate approval and plugin-binding policy manually.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit relocation
recommendation.body: Keep isolation as the default but require a deliberate source-and-target-confirmed doctor action to migrate old approval state.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored both the recent merged capability-gated behavior and the current removal, providing the strongest available context for the intended boundary.
